name: manual_9d1013
claim: When a vendored submodule (agentic-stack) ships upgrades to a directory PT customized in-tree (.agent/), the AlphaClaw reverse-merge precedent (upstream always prevails on the integration line, but local customizations sit on the RECEIVING end of a union merge, never the source) maps to file-level 3-way merges via 'git merge-file base ours theirs', not a branch-level reverse-merge, since .agent/ isn't its own submodule/branch. Tool: scripts/git/agentic-stack-agent-blend.sh (status/apply/promote); base SHA tracked in .agent/.agentic-stack-blend-state.json, seeded from .agent/install.json's original scaffold version.

decisions.notes: Built and validated 2026-07-11 for the v0.9.0->v0.18.0 agentic-stack bump (PR #208): 18 clean merges (verified recall.py's UTF-8 customization survived), 7 genuine conflicts surfaced honestly (tools/learn.py: PT's sanitize_tracked_path_leaks() vs upstream's datetime.timezone.utc fix, same line), 2 Brain files correctly blocked per doc 41 §5. Never advance the blend-state base while any file is still conflicted, or the next cycle diffs from the wrong point and silently drops upstream's intervening changes for those files.
